# t7.5.1 — Security Review: Memory, Policy Loading, and Capability Boundaries

## Summary

Read-only review of the t7.5 increment found no security vulnerability in the reviewed bounded memory persistence, prompt/rules loading, or named agent/skill capability boundaries. The reviewed implementation remains opt-in, provider-neutral, and bounded; no autonomous application mutations or raw browser `Page` exposure were identified in the reviewed code.

This conclusion is limited to the scoped changes and inspected files. It is not a general security sign-off for the repository or future injected adapters.

## Scope and Review Method

- Reviewed file-backed memory CRUD, memory contracts, policy parser, prompt/rules JSON examples, named agents, skill registry and modules, rules engine, orchestration and related contracts, tests, exports, Cucumber runtime integration, and the framework documentation.
- A read-only security-review agent performed the source review and ran the deterministic test suite and TypeScript build.
- No browser journeys, external provider, target system, or credentials were accessed.
- Cross-process memory concurrency was not tested; the store documents single-process use.

## Findings

No confirmed findings in scope.

## Security Notes and Limitations

- Local file memory is opt-in and non-encrypted. Its suitability depends on filesystem access controls and the sensitivity of stored values; use an approved transactional, access-controlled, encrypted adapter for shared or sensitive production use.
- Cross-process concurrency behavior was not verified. Do not treat atomic replacement as a guarantee of transactional multi-process coordination.
- Concrete injected skill/provider adapters remain trusted integration code and need their own security review before enablement.
- This review does not reassess unrelated, previously recorded repository concerns (including TLS validation and diagnostic logging); they are not cleared by this scoped result.
- No external RAG/vector store, remote provider, or production API/database adapter was tested or is claimed by this review.

## Verification

- `npm test` — passed, 26 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped.
- `npm run build` — passed (`tsc --noEmit`, exit code 0).
- Browser/Cucumber target journeys — not run, as instructed.
